ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a series circuit, with switch S on the left, bulbs L1 and L2 connected in sequence above, ammeter A connected in series at the lower right, and power supply E at the bottom. The two ends of voltmeter V are respectively connected to the nodes at the left and right ends of L2, so the voltmeter is connected in parallel with L2. Reasoning: After switch S is closed, if the circuit is normal, the current should pass through L1, L2, the ammeter, and the power supply to form a closed loop. Now the ammeter reading is 0, indicating that there is an open circuit in the main series loop. The voltmeter reading is 6 V, and it is connected in parallel across the two ends of L2, indicating that the two ends of L2 bear the power supply voltage. If bulb L2 itself is open-circuited, the main loop has no current, so the ammeter is 0; at the same time, the voltmeter is connected across the two ends of the open L2, and can still measure the power supply voltage 6 V. Therefore, the fault may be an open circuit in the L2 bulb circuit.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, composed of four batteries, after the switch S is closed, the voltmeter reading is 6V, and the ammeter reading is 0. The possible cause of the fault is a break in the ________ circuit.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit layout: after S is closed, current would normally pass through L1, then L2, then the ammeter and battery. The voltmeter is in parallel with L2. From the text, A reads 0, so the main series circuit has an open circuit. Since V reads 6 V, the two terminals of L2 have a potential difference equal to the battery voltage. This happens if L2 itself is broken/open: no current flows through the main path, but the voltmeter across the broken L2 still measures the supply voltage. Therefore the fault is a break in the L2 lamp circuit.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个串联电路，左侧有开关 S，上方依次连接灯泡 L1 和灯泡 L2，右下方串联有电流表 A，底部有电源 E。电压表 V 的两端分别接在 L2 左右两端的节点上，因此电压表与 L2 并联。推理：开关 S 闭合后，如果电路正常，电流应经过 L1、L2、电流表和电源形成闭合回路。现在电流表读数为 0，说明主串联回路中存在断路。电压表读数为 6 V，且它并联在 L2 两端，说明 L2 两端承受了电源电压。若 L2 灯泡本身断路，主回路无电流，所以电流表为 0；同时电压表跨接在断开的 L2 两端，仍可测到电源电压 6 V。因此故障可能是 L2 灯泡电路断路。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the image that L1 and L2 are in the main series path with switch S, battery E, and ammeter A, and that the voltmeter V is connected directly across the two terminals of lamp L2.

method.method_draft: Map the voltmeter leads to circuit nodes. The right voltmeter lead is connected through the right wire and ammeter side to one battery terminal. The left voltmeter lead can be connected to the other battery terminal only through the closed switch and L1. Since the voltmeter reads the full 6 V, those external connections must still be intact, placing the battery voltage across the two terminals where L2 sits. Yet the ammeter reads 0, so no normal current passes through the series lamp path. The only consistent break is in the branch/component between the same two voltmeter nodes, namely lamp L2. Thus the blank is L2 lamp.
